card.text: M70 is a globular star cluster in the Milky Way, about 9,360 parsecs away.

sources.quote: Messier 70 or M70, also known as NGC 6681, is a globular cluster of stars to be found in the south of Sagittarius.

introduction.text: M70 is drawn as 419 of its member stars, measured by Gaia; each dot sits at its sky position, at the cluster's distance.
